subject: Film & Cinema
title: Disney's Dark Side: Controversy and Control
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Disney's Dark Side: Controversy and Control.

hook.text: Disney created magic. Disney also crushed competitors, overworked artists, and extended copyright law.

buildup.text: Walt Disney was a creative genius and a union-busting, controlling perfectionist.

discovery.text: The 1941 animators' strike exposed brutal working conditions behind the cheerful cartoons.

twist.text: Disney lobbied Congress to extend copyright — the 'Mickey Mouse Protection Act' delayed public domain.

climax.text: Understanding Disney means seeing both the artistry and the power plays.

punchline.text: The happiest brand has the fiercest lawyers.

quiz.question: What was the 1941 Disney animators' strike about?
options: Brutal working conditions behind the cheerful cartoons
